claims.title: The registry cannot be changed
claims.proof: Code on chain, no proxy slots, no owner or setter in the ABI.

claims.title: A Specialist is bonded and assigned
claims.proof: A bond transaction, and an assignment that spent one HybridAuth leaf (ECDSA and SHRINCS).
claims.passes: Both exist, from the same address.

claims.title: The auction duty is measured
claims.proof: AuctionDutyRecorded for each cycle, matching the auction contract's own order events.
claims.passes: Every recorded cycle agrees with the auction.

claims.title: The floor duty is measured
claims.proof: Checkpoint events, each matching the position and the pool tick at its block.
claims.passes: Every checkpoint agrees with the chain at its block.

claims.title: Scoring follows the rules
claims.proof: Each EpochScored recomputed from the checkpoint and cycle events.
claims.passes: The recomputed outcome equals the emitted one.

claims.title: Rewards are paid
claims.proof: A Rewarded event after a passing epoch, with the USDG transfer.
claims.passes: The transfer exists and equals the event.

claims.title: Slashing works
claims.proof: A Slashed event after a missed duty, with the BELL burn transfer.
claims.passes: The burn transfer exists and equals the event.

claims.title: Unbonding cannot dodge a bad epoch
claims.proof: A slash applied after UnbondRequested and before Unbonded.

claims.title: Exits stay open
claims.proof: The Specialist withdraws liquidity without a hook call, and D2 fails for the next checkpoint.
claims.passes: The withdrawal succeeded, the hook has no remove-liquidity flag, and the next checkpoint failed.
